latency.method: nearest rank over 6 end-to-end call latencies (non-streaming; queue time not separable); with 6 samples p95 is the largest value — an operational check, not a statistically robust estimate

criteria.name: no call reached the 90 s timeout
complete usage accounting
criteria.detail: every answered call reported prompt and completion tokens; every failed call kept its whole reservation

criteria.name: total usage within 16,800 tokens (or the overrun flagged and charged)

assertions.name: never more calls than the ceiling
one application call per sent call
one physical request per call at the transport boundary
one model request per call on the wire
every sent pair ends classified or failed (none in flight or pending)
a failed call fails exactly its own pairs and keeps its reservation
no pair classified without a validated answer
ledger, budget and call records agree
within the token and dollar ceilings (worst case)
